title: 静寂の閾、ノイズの残滓
author: 灰原 ユキト

en.title: Threshold of Silence, Remnants of Noise
en.premise: Every sound is regulated for the sake of order. Ren, an Acoustic Auditor, spends his days dispassionately performing his duty: detecting and erasing irregular sounds—the so-called "noise." But one morning, he encounters a trembling human voice streaming from the forbidden "Dawn Radio." It is the raw resonance of life, a sound that the managed silence has long sought to conceal.

zh.title: 静寂之阈，噪声之残渣
zh.premise: 为了维持秩序，所有的声音都受到严密的管控。音响审计官 Ren 每天机械地执行着任务：探测并抹除那些不规则的声音——即所谓的“噪声”。然而，某天清晨，他偶然听到了从被禁的“黎明广播”中传出的、那颤抖的人声。那是被管控的静寂所掩盖的、生命最原始的共鸣。
